title: The “Right” Discourse on Migration: Analysing Migration-Related Tweets in Right and Far-Right Political Movements
measurement_description: The paper evaluated the discourse of right and far-right political movements on Twitter concerning migration. In relation to religion, it identified and tracked the prevalence of Islamophobic narratives, such as the 'Great Replacement' conspiracy theory targeting migrants from Muslim countries, and fearmongering regarding 'ISIS terrorist infiltration' and 'jihadists' within European borders.
findings: The study found that far-right political discourse extensively links migration to threats of Islamic terrorism (e.g., topics like 'ISIS terrorist infiltration via migrant surge') and propagates the 'Great Replacement' conspiracy theory, racializing the threat and specifically focusing on migrants from Muslim countries.
